title: Focal Length Far Point
description: Essential Criteria: The focal length at the far point must be correctly calculated as 1.987 cm.

title: Focal Length Near Point
description: Essential Criteria: The focal length at the near point must be correctly calculated as 1.961 cm.

title: Lens Strength Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The strength of the lens required for 25 cm must be correctly calculated as 33.3 cm.

title: Correct Use of Lens Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the lens formula for both near and far points.

title: Power Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the dioptric power of the lens must be correctly derived.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the lens formula or power calculations.

title: Final Answer Presentation
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers should be clearly presented with appropriate units.
